visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Logo lockup → 'ESTATE SALE' (navy) / 'ONLINE AUCTION' (blue) uppercase → spaced-caps support → four blue icon rows (categories + local pickup) → blue CTA 'BROWSE & BID TODAY →' → navy band (Explore / Bid / Win) + 'You Can Do This.' → footer strip. Right: a stone house with boxwoods and, in front of it, furniture staged outdoors on a rug.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Chest of drawers with a lamp and blue-and-white jars, gilt paintings, a tufted armchair, coffee table with books and a plant, trunk, bronze horse, a chalkboard 'Great Pieces Find New Homes.' — staged on a rug in front of the house.
visual_read.composition_style: Copy column left over a light haze; environmental house exterior right; merchandise on the lawn; band closes.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Uppercase condensed display in navy/blue; script accents with a blue underline.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Logo lockup large; band script; no seller, no event facts.
visual_read.photographic_style: Image-model rendered exterior with staged furniture; bright daylight.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Furniture staged outdoors in front of a house — a 'the estate' environment, not a room.

strongest_attributes: Event type as the headline ('Estate Sale / Online Auction') — the prominence the Owner asked for
The house itself as the environment — an estate reads as an estate
transferable_lessons: 'Estate Sale' + 'Online Auction' stacked as a two-line event-type headline is an approved pattern for generic estate-auction creative
An exterior with staged merchandise is an acceptable environmental treatment for GENERIC estate creative (a real event uses its real photographs)
Category icon rows may name what buyers will find
do_not_generalize: The buyer-facing copy as SELLER acquisition copy — the folder says seller, the words say buyer; see the unresolved question in the 3P.2 report
The house — generic; a real event never borrows an exterior
'Convenient Local Pickup' — a service claim requiring production truth
Absence of date/place — a real estate-sale creative must carry its facts
